title: risk_scoring — deterministic risk-gate configuration (P2.4)
description: Weights and band thresholds for the risk_scored gate. The score is pure arithmetic over kernel-observed signals (guards, budget verdict, checks, retries) — no model output plays any part in it. The kernel, not configuration, owns the band-to-action mapping (low -> auto_advance, medium -> awaiting_human, high -> blocked): tuning may re-weight what raises the score, never renegotiate what a band does. Absent at runtime, the kernel's documented defaults (equal to the shipped factory.json block) apply.

weights.description: Points one occurrence of each signal adds to the score. Output is clamped to the threshold cap, so sums can exceed it.

guard_violation.description: Per guard violation (kernel disqualification signal: an anti-cheating guard failed on the diff).

budget_soft_exceeded.description: Added once when the attempt's budget verdict is soft_exceeded (work stands, limit proven leaky).

budget_hard_exceeded.description: Added once when the attempt's budget verdict is hard_exceeded. Weights are operator-tunable, but the kernel asserts nothing here; a config that prices a hard breach at zero is legal by design — the hard stop itself is not tunable (it fails the attempt independently of the gate).

check_failure.description: Per failing check in the attempt's checks.json.

retry_attempt.description: Per retry of the stage: attempt_number - 1. Struggle is evidence, not proof.

injection_flag.description: Per injection flag detected on an untrusted manifest item.

thresholds.description: Band ceilings, not floors: score < low -> low, < medium -> medium, otherwise high. 'high' doubles as the score's clamp cap, so a 100 score saturates the highest band. The loader additionally enforces low < medium <= high (JSON Schema cannot express cross-key strict ordering).
